    If he looked at the Insomniac, he would wake up at the end of the night.
    He says "I was the Insomniac... I have the Doppelganger now". This is contradictory. If he was the Insomniac, he couldn't "have the Doppelganger now" unless he was swapped. But the Doppelganger is a starting role. You can't "become" the Doppelganger. You can be the Doppelganger and become another role.

    So Dustin is lying. He says he was the Insomniac and now he's the Doppelganger. That's impossible. You can't swap into the Doppelganger role and then know you were the Insomniac unless you are the Insomniac and were swapped with the Doppelganger. But if he was the Insomniac and was swapped with the Doppelganger, he wouldn't know he was the Insomniac (the Insomniac wakes up at the *end* of the night).

    If he was the Insomniac and was swapped with the Doppelganger, he would wake up and see the Doppelganger card.
    So he would know he is now the Doppelganger, but he wouldn't know he *was* the Insomniac.
    Unless he's lying about being the Insomniac.

    Let's re-read: "Dustin: Yes, I was the Insomniac... I told you I have the Doppelganger now".
    This is a contradiction. If he woke up as the Insomniac, he knows his *current* card is Insomniac. If he then says he has the Doppelganger, he's lying about one of them.

    Conclusion: Dustin is lying and is likely the Werewolf (swapped with Dylan).

    Dustin: Insomniac (start) -> Werewolf (end)
